name: 致恶灵的你（To You, the Evil Spirit）
detailed_description:
🕯️ Game Introduction
The scorching summer air buzzes with the cries of cicadas—sharp, oppressive, and almost conspiratorial.
My assistant Ashari and I received a mysterious email from someone calling herself the “Snow White of the Clocktower.”
She offered a generous sum to bring us to the far-off city of Arlan to investigate a string of deadly spirit-related murders.
Night is falling. The prey has yet to appear...
And so, our story quietly begins—on the very first evening of our arrival in Arlan City.

✨ About the Game
To You, the Evil Spirit is a visual novel that blends mystery, adventure, and romantic elements.
You play as a cynical “spirit detective,” accompanied by your tsundere assistant Ashari, invited to the exotic offshore metropolis of Arlan City to hunt down vicious, otherworldly entities.
As the story unfolds, you'll explore the foreign charm of Arlan Island, meet a wide cast of characters, and slowly uncover the terrifying secrets hidden beneath the mist-shrouded Arlan Tree.

💫 Game Features

  • A unique and original setting: a fantasy metropolis blending multicultural aesthetics

  • Deep character interactions and branching scenes guided by carefully written narrative choices

  • Follow the thread of fate toward an inevitable final conclusion alongside Ashari

  • Immersive reading experience with detailed AI-assisted character illustrations and atmospheric background music

  • Light supernatural horror elements and flirtatious dialogue create subtle but tantalizing psychological tension

📖 Current Game Content
The current version includes two full chapters of the main story, with over 500,000 words of content and an estimated 5–8 hours of playtime:

◉ Prologue: The First Night
The protagonist and Ashari arrive in Arlan City.
This chapter mostly mirrors the original demo version, with minor revisions to better align with the worldbuilding and overall narrative direction.

◉ Chapter One: The Chainsaw Spirit (Part 1)
Early in the investigation, you encounter Selama—a mysterious, wealthy Black beauty.
The three of you share a small but intense adventure, sparking moments of romantic tension and coming face-to-face with a horrifying chainsaw-wielding spirit.

◉ Chapter Two: The Chainsaw Spirit (Part 2)
As the case deepens, the true face of Arlan City begins to emerge.
You’ll join forces with local exorcists to battle the chainsaw spirit.
During a brief moment of respite, you'll also visit the opulent Golden Coast Casino—experiencing a dazzling side of Arlan’s vibrant urban life.

🧩 System Overview

  • Linear story progression with a strong focus on character development and emotional atmosphere

  • Multiple choices influence character interactions and minor plot branches, but the story ultimately leads to a unified ending

  • Future chapters will be added via Early Access episodic updates

short_description: Together with Ashari, we set out to hunt the ruthless Chainsaw Wraith— peril lurks at every corner, hidden currents stir beneath the surface, and a quiet tension of desire begins to bloom. An unknown adventure is about to unfold.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (32-bit/64-bit)
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz Dual-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (e.g., Intel HD Graphics)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains suggestive dialogue with flirtatious elements, frequent strong language, supernatural themes, and some scenes featuring revealing outfits and partial nudity.
There is no explicit depiction of sexual acts or excessive gore.
Some lines of dialogue may include satirical or political commentary, as well as minor LGBTQ-related content.
